# hoop_server_auth_config (Resource)

Manages the gateway's authentication configuration, the one row behind Settings → Authentication on a self-hosted gateway. Every apply writes the whole row: an attribute left out here is cleared on the gateway, including values set in the web app. There is one row per gateway and it cannot be deleted; destroying the resource only forgets it. A multi-tenant gateway refuses the route.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

variable "oidc_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# The whole row is written on every apply: an attribute left out here is
# cleared on the gateway.
resource "hoop_server_auth_config" "this" {
  auth_method = "oidc"

  oidc_config = {
    issuer_url    = "https://auth.example.com/oidc"
    client_id     = "hoop"
    client_secret = var.oidc_client_secret
    scopes        = ["groups"]
    audience      = "hoop-gateway"
    groups_claim  = "groups"
  }

  provider_name                  = "Okta"
  webapp_users_management_status = "inactive"
  admin_role_name                = "admin"
  auditor_role_name              = "auditor"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_method` (String) How users sign in: `local` (gateway-managed accounts), `oidc` or `saml`. `oidc` needs `oidc_config`, `saml` needs `saml_config`.
- `webapp_users_management_status` (String) `active` lets admins create, edit and delete users in the web app; `inactive` leaves users to the identity provider.

### Optional

- `admin_role_name` (String) The group that grants administrator access. Defaults to `admin`. The gateway authorizes admin routes against this group right away, so the API key the provider uses must belong to the new group (or be the gateway's legacy `API_KEY`) before the change is applied, or the next refresh answers 403.
- `auditor_role_name` (String) The group that grants auditor access. Defaults to `auditor`.
- `oidc_config` (Attributes) The OIDC / OAuth2 identity provider. The gateway reaches the issuer when the row is written and refuses the write when it cannot. Leaving the block out clears the stored OIDC settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc_config))
- `provider_name` (String) The identity provider's name, shown on the sign-in page. Leaving it out stores none.
- `saml_config` (Attributes) The SAML 2.0 identity provider. The gateway fetches the metadata when the row is written and refuses the write when it cannot. Leaving the block out clears the stored SAML settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml_config))

### Read-Only

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The admin api key stored in the row after a key rollout; null until one happened. Rollouts are not managed here.
- `id` (String) Always `server`: a gateway has one row.

<a id="nestedatt--oidc_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc_config`

Required:

- `client_id` (String) The OAuth2 client id.
- `issuer_url` (String) The issuer URL, such as `https://auth.example.com/oidc`.

Optional:

- `audience` (String) The OAuth2 audience. Leaving it out stores none.
- `client_assertion_file` (String) Path on the gateway to a JWT that authenticates the client in place of `client_secret` (RFC 7523). It must be the path the gateway operator set in `IDP_CLIENT_ASSERTION_FILE`.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The OAuth2 client secret. Set it or `client_assertion_file`, not both.
- `groups_claim` (String) The token claim that carries the user's groups. Defaults to `groups`.
- `scopes` (List of String) Extra OAuth2 scopes appended to `openid`, `profile` and `email`. Leaving it out stores none.


<a id="nestedatt--saml_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `saml_config`

Required:

- `idp_metadata_url` (String) The identity provider metadata URL.

Optional:

- `groups_claim` (String) The assertion attribute that carries the user's groups. Defaults to `groups`.

Read-Only:

- `resolved_metadata` (Attributes) What the metadata URL resolved to on the last write, so the IdP can be checked. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml_config--resolved_metadata))

<a id="nestedatt--saml_config--resolved_metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `saml_config.resolved_metadata`

Read-Only:

- `certificate_expires_at` (String) When the newest signing certificate in the metadata expires, RFC 3339.
- `entity_id` (String) The entity id declared in the metadata document.
- `resolved_at` (String) When the metadata was fetched, RFC 3339.
- `sso_url` (String) The single sign-on URL users are redirected to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

terraform import hoop_server_auth_config.this server
```
